who: Sam, a designer with a small studio, a partner and a six-year-old
talk:
Okay, so, I'm Sam, I live in Utrecht with my partner Lena and our daughter Noor, she's six. I run a small design studio with two people, Tom and Priya, and honestly the studio takes most of my head at the moment. Our biggest client, a bank, wants the new website proposal by Friday, and I haven't started the budget part yet, so that's the thing that keeps me up. I also need to send Priya her contract renewal, I keep forgetting, and I owe the accountant the third quarter invoices, he asked twice already.

At home, we pay the mortgage on the first of every month, and I promised Lena I'd sort out the school holiday plan for Noor, because nothing is booked and the camp fills up. My mother turns seventy next month and I want to plan something for her, I haven't called her in a while either, I should call her this week.

Health wise, my back hurts from sitting all day. The doctor told me to see a physio and I still haven't booked it. I used to run and I'd really like to get back to running twice a week, and sleep better, I go to bed way too late.

What do I want from this year? I want the studio to stop depending on that one bank, so two new clients by summer would be great. And I want to actually be home for dinner most evenings instead of working until nine. Someday I'd love to take a whole month off and go to Japan with the family, but that's a dream for now.

I think that's most of it. There's so much in my head, that's why I'm trying this.
now: Getting the budget for the bank proposal done.
